title: Booking Lead-Time Bands for Missed First Appointments on Appointment Series
content:
Rate card — lead-time share in the fee for a missed first appointment of an Appointment Series.

**Rule.** The first-appointment lead-time share is measured from the date the booking that holds the first appointment was made to the series start date, in calendar days: it is 50 percent where that booking was made no more than 2 days ahead, 75 percent where it was made more than 2 but no more than 6 days ahead, and 100 percent where it was made more than 6 days ahead. The share is read as a percentage of the first-appointment no-show basis and multiplies it.

**Which booking.** The booking entry on the series whose first appointment is dated on the series start date, by the date it was made (the most recent such entry). Where the series shows no such booking entry, the date the series was set up is used.

| Calendar days between the booking date and the series start date | Lead-time share |
|---|---|
| 0, 1 or 2 | 50 percent |
| 3, 4, 5 or 6 | 75 percent |
| 7 or more | 100 percent |

**Band edges.** 2 days ahead is 50 percent and 3 days 75 percent; 6 days ahead is 75 percent and 7 days 100 percent.

**Example (hypothetical figures).** First appointment on 14 March booked on 10 March: 4 days ahead, so 75 percent; on a basis of USD 50.00 that is USD 37.50.
